risk_summary: The disclosure quantifies a severe revenue decline from $34.2 million to $6.8 million, driven by reduced COVID-19 test demand, and references material goodwill impairment and inventory-obsolescence risk. Promotional and forward-looking claims are balanced by substantial regulatory, commercialization, demand, valuation, and tax-estimation uncertainties. Overall, the tone is cautiously negative despite optimistic descriptions of proprietary technology and future applications.
